files = {item["path"]: item for item in base["files"]}
added = [item["path"] for item in delta if item["path"] not in files]
files.update({item["path"]: item for item in delta})
for name, item in files.items():

    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == item["sha256"], name
    assert len(data) == item["bytes"], name
    assert data.count(b"\r\n") == item["crlf"], name

def source(name):
    return Path(files[name]["source_path"]) if name in files else ROOT / name

def read(name):
    return source(name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

tasks = json.loads(read("design/tasks.json"))["tasks"]
by_id = {task["id"]: task for task in tasks}
assert len(by_id) == len(tasks) == 25
active, visited, order = set(), set(), []

def visit(task_id):
    assert task_id not in active, "cycle: " + task_id
    if task_id in visited:
        return
    active.add(task_id)
    for dependency in by_id[task_id]["depends_on"]:
        visit(dependency)
    active.remove(task_id)
    visited.add(task_id)
    order.append(task_id)

for task_id in by_id:
